notes: Single-file polished Plants vs Zombies clone. Canvas lawn grid 9x5 with plants (Peashooter, Sunflower, Wall-nut, Repeater, Cherry Bomb), zombies (normal + cone), projectile peas, sun drops to collect, coins, score, wave system, selection bar, start/game-over menus, localStorage leaderboard (top 10), HP bars, and a cherry-bomb AOE explosion.
